important_information: Demonstrates separating slower target selection (0.25-second loop) from per-frame facing updates.

title: Advanced vector operations: Dot Product and Cross Product
important_information: For normalized direction D, Dot Product(V,D) is signed directional magnitude; projection is D*Dot(D,V), residual is V minus projection.
Impulse using negative residual direction and its magnitude with Incorporate Contrary Motion removes off-axis momentum; scaling magnitude removes a fraction.
Cross-product operand order changes the sign; parallel vectors yield zero magnitude.
Build camera-relative right/up axes from normalized cross products, then position an entity at eye + facing*depth + right*x + up*y.
uncertainties: Screen-space construction has no explicit fallback when facing is parallel to world Up; cross products become zero.
Projection identities require normalized D as stated; treating arbitrary direction magnitude as unit would change results.

Cross-source contradiction: tutorial says Forward cross Right is Up, but archived axis constants give Forward=(0,0,1), Right=(-1,0,0), and its stated cross-product formula yields Down. Articles 4585/4686/4732/4758 support the axis convention; correct/retest the example.

title: How To Use Loops
important_information: Rule loops repeat an entire action list; While/End repeat a scoped block and then continue with subsequent actions.
Repeated/unbounded loops need waits to pace work and avoid exhausting server execution; bounded small for-loops can intentionally run without waits.
For-loop example iterates zero-based array indices from zero to Count Of exclusive and applies per-target operations separately.
Use a player-owned loop index/state for concurrently running Each Player loops.
uncertainties: Article describes a 0.016-second minimum wait and unconditional no-wait crash behavior; preserve as archived guidance, not a precise modern scheduling proof.
For-loop prose assumes positive steps and describes condition check after body; empty/reversed ranges and negative steps require authoritative action-level verification.

important_information: Update Every Frame increases update frequency for conditions and reevaluating action parameters; it can smooth positions/effects/cameras and sharpen positional triggers.

title: Workshop.codes API
important_information: Wiki JSON endpoints are obtained by appending .json to article/overview/category URLs; pagination supports /page/2 or ?page=2.
Wiki list pages are documented as 24 entries with no page count; end is HTTP 200 with empty array.
Wiki search returns at most 20 results with Markdown cleaned for Discord, so it is not a complete raw-corpus enumeration method.
Dictionary endpoint supplies action/value names only, without server-side filtering.
Hero/map/ability JSON endpoints provide metadata and image URLs; abilities can filter by tag or name.
API is explicitly described as informal/brittle and concurrent search can return 500 errors.
uncertainties: Code-list pagination claims conflict: 24 in general section versus 20 for homepage/filter page parameter.
Search examples alternate search and query parameters; cannot assume both without API validation.
No-request-limit statement does not remove need for conservative refresh rates/retries.
Archived API descriptions were read only; no network or HTML scraping performed.
